title: [Classic Epic RPG] Struggling with Creating Endgame Events

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】終盤のイベント作成に悩む
blocks.translation: [Classic Epic RPG] Struggling with Creating Endgame Events

blocks.source: そろそろ本気でネタ切れなので、RPG制作講座及びRPGレビューの更新ペースは落とします。無理に捻り出せば毎週で書けないことも無いですが、ネタが枯渇するに従って更新に掛かる時間も増えてきたので辛いです。本業のRPG制作がシナリオの重要部分に入ってきたのもあって、そっちを優先します。
blocks.translation: I'm seriously running out of things to write about, so I'm going to slow down the update pace for the RPG Design Guides and RPG reviews. I could force myself to come up with something every week, but as my ideas have dried up, the time required for each update has also increased, and it's becoming difficult. Since my main RPG project has reached an important part of its scenario, I'm going to prioritize that instead.

blocks.source: 元々からして、定期的に更新するという一般的なブログの使い方は余り考えておらず、書いた文章を溜めておければ何でもいいやって感じでした。以後は思い付いた時に書くっていう感じでいこうかなと思います。この開発記録に付いては、元から数ヶ月に一回程度しか更新していなかったので、どの道今まで通りです。本当はもうちょっと頻繁に更新したいところですが。
blocks.translation: From the beginning, I wasn't really thinking of using this like a typical blog with regular updates. I was more of the mindset that it would be fine as long as I had somewhere to accumulate the things I wrote. From now on, I think I'll just write whenever I have an idea. As for this Development Log, I was only updating it once every few months to begin with, so in any case, it will continue as usual. I would actually like to update it a little more frequently, though.

blocks.source: RPG制作講座に付いては、当初の予定以上の分量になりました。記事によっては、内容を盛り込みすぎて焦点がブレてたりとか、画像とか具体的な例とかもっと入れた方が良いのではないかとか、気になる点もありますので、ちょくちょく整理して行きたいと思います。
blocks.translation: The RPG Design Guides have grown longer than I originally planned. In some articles, I may have included too much content and caused the focus to become blurred, or perhaps I should add more images and concrete examples. There are various things that concern me, so I would like to organize them from time to time.

blocks.source: RPGレビューに付いては、古い作品は記憶が薄れているのが大変です。できれば昔の作品のレビューを書くにしても、ユーザインタフェースの再確認ぐらいはしたいのですが・・・。目標の１００作品まではまだまだ遠いですね。ていうか新作をやりたいですが時間が作れません。
blocks.translation: As for the RPG reviews, it's difficult because my memories of older games have faded. Ideally, even when writing reviews of older games, I would at least like to revisit their user interfaces, but... I'm still a long way from my goal of 100 games. Actually, I want to play new releases, but I can't find the time.
Now, on to the development status.

blocks.source: 火山地帯というイメージで町を作りましたがどうでしょう。何となく草がうまく描けた気がします。もう少し幻想的な風景もあるのですが、後半ともなるとネタバレ成分が高くて余り晒せません。
blocks.translation: I created a town with a volcanic-region theme. What do you think? Somehow, I feel like I managed to draw the grass well. There are also some more fantastical landscapes, but since this is the latter half of the game, they contain too many spoilers for me to show much of them.

blocks.source: 魚とカエルです。水の表現というか色使いは昔と比べると、随分落ち着いて綺麗になったはずです。下の旧バージョンと比べれば一目瞭然。
blocks.translation: These are fish and frogs. Compared to the past, the depiction of water—or rather, the color scheme—should have become much more subdued and beautiful. It's obvious at a glance when compared with the old version below.

blocks.source: ここ半年程、１週間に付き『１ダンジョン、または１イベントを作成する』というのを自分に課してきました。これまでは順調には進んでいたものの、ここに至ってちょっとストップです。
blocks.translation: For about the past six months, I have been imposing on myself the goal of creating one dungeon or one event per week. Things had been progressing smoothly until now, but I've come to a bit of a standstill.

blocks.source: というのも、『シナリオの重要部分』と書いた通り、ラストダンジョンに繋がる終盤のイベントの作成に取り掛かるからです。重要なところなので、無理に完成させるというわけにもいかず、じっくりと脚本を練らねばなりません。加えて、序盤のイベントとの整合性も取る必要があるのも難点です。今まで、「とりあえず適当でいいや」という感じに置いていたところとも、そろそろ真面目に向き合う必要があります。
blocks.translation: The reason is that, as I wrote, this is an "important part of the scenario," and I'm about to start creating the endgame events that lead to the final dungeon. Since this is an important section, I can't simply force it to completion; I need to carefully develop the script. In addition, I need to ensure consistency with the events from the early part of the game, which is another difficult point. It's also time to seriously confront the parts that I had previously left in place with an attitude of "good enough for now."

blocks.source: ちなみに中盤に付いては、いわゆるDQ3におけるオーブ探しのようなものなので、基本的に進行の順序は不同です。よって、整合性に関してはさほど問題はありません。だからこそ、このところ順調に進んでいたというわけですが。
blocks.translation: As for the middle of the game, it is essentially like searching for orbs in DQ3, so the order of progression is basically non-linear. Therefore, consistency isn't much of a problem. That is precisely why things had been progressing smoothly lately.

blocks.source: 重要部分の脚本を書き始めてみると、伝えるべき情報量が多くて忙しいイベントになりそうです。これを自然に伝えるためには、どうすればいいかと日々頭を悩ませています。ですが、何とかここを乗り越えてストーリー完成までの道筋を付けたいと思います。
blocks.translation: Now that I've started writing the script for the important section, it looks like it will be a hectic event with a great deal of information to convey. I rack my brain every day trying to figure out how to communicate it naturally. Still, I hope to somehow overcome this hurdle and pave the way to completing the story.
